rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for something based on real practice rather than theory, and for a person who is down-to-earth and practical.

example.english: They are very practical and do not just talk theory.
example.traditional: 佢做嘢好實際，唔會淨係講理論。
example.jyutping: keoi5 zou6 je5 hou2 sat6 zai3 m4 wui5 zing6 hai6 gong2 lei5 leon6

rows.note: Use this for an object, skill, or idea that is useful and can be put to practical use.

example.english: This storage bag is cheap and practical.
example.traditional: 呢個收納袋又平又實用。
example.jyutping: ni1 go3 sau1 naap6 doi6 jau6 peng4 jau6 sat6 jung6

rows.note: Use this specifically when “practical” means feasible or workable in a real situation rather than merely useful.

example.english: Your proposal sounds practical, so we can give it a try.
example.traditional: 你個方案聽落可行，我哋可以試吓。
example.jyutping: nei5 go3 fong1 on3 teng1 lok6 ho2 hang4 ngo5 dei6 ho2 ji5 si3 haa5
